info.title: Magic Lantern
info.description:
The HTTP API of the Magic Lantern daemon. Errors use one envelope: `{ error, message, issues? }`, where `error` is a stable kebab-case code.

Beyond the answers each operation lists, any request can get 500 `internal` (the cause is only in the daemon's log), and an unknown API route, or a documented path under a method it does not list, gets 404 `not-found` (never 405).

session.name: lantern_session
session.description: Set by `POST /api/v1/session`. In auth mode `password` every `/api/v1` route except `/api/v1/session` requires it; in mode `none` nothing does.

get.summary: Backend kinds and their settings schemas
get.description: The kinds this daemon can add, each with JSON Schema for its settings and secrets, for the add form (A26).

200.description: The backend kinds this daemon knows.

schema.description: The backend kinds this daemon knows.

items.description: A backend kind this daemon can add.

secrets_schema.description: JSON Schema for its `secrets`; an object with no properties when it has none.

default_urls.description: Where autodetect looks for it on this machine (A32).

post.summary: Look for backends, and propose how to add them
post.description: Runs each kind's probes, by path (L9): an sd-server answers `/sdcpp/v1/capabilities` (port 1234 by default) and Lemonade `/api/v1/health` (13305, or 8000 on older releases). With `url`, tests that address as every kind instead. Each find carries a proposal (A26): the models it serves, with a family guess and its confidence. Nothing is added.

schema.description: What to probe.

url.description: A URL to test as every kind that can be probed. Absent: each kind's default addresses on this machine.

schema.description: What autodetect found (A32).

items.description: A backend found by a probe: the proposal card.

registered.description: The backend already registered at this address, if any.

anyOf.description: A backend id: `be_` and a ULID, or the stable id `lantern.json` gives it.

models.description: What it serves now. A manager may serve none until a model is loaded.

items.description: A model a detected backend serves now.

name.description: A display name to start from.

fingerprint.description: A model's identity (L4), compared whole when a model reappears (A26).

anyOf.description: A file the backend reports.

path.description: The model file, as the backend names it.

stem.description: Its name without directory or extension.

definition_hash.description: A hash over every file the model uses.

existing.description: The model this fingerprint already is, when Lantern knows it (A26).

anyOf.description: A model id.

guess.description: A guess at a model's profile, from its name.

family.description: A profile family, or `generic` (backend defaults).

confidence.description: `high`: the file names the family outright. `medium`: a likely reading. `low`: a guess. `none`: no idea, so the generic profile.

reason.description: What the guess is based on, for people.

items.description: One probe and what came of it.

detail.description: Why not, when it was not found.

get.description: Server-sent events: `job.updated`, `job.progress`, `asset.created`, `backend.health` and `reset`, each with a JSON `data` line. Event ids are `<boot id>:<sequence>`; reconnecting with `Last-Event-ID` replays what was missed, or sends `reset` when that id is unknown (another boot, or too long ago), after which a client refetches. A comment line every 15 s keeps proxies from closing the stream.

get.description: Assets newest first, filtered and paged by a cursor. Pages stay consistent while assets are added: a new asset never shifts one already seen onto the next page.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Prompt search over the positive and negative prompts of the job that made each asset. Every word must appear; `long_hair` is one word.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Only outputs of this model.

parameters.name: route
parameters.description: Only outputs of this route.

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: Only outputs of jobs in this client collection (a client's own grouping).

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: `generated`: a job made it. `uploaded`: sent to this library. `derived`: made by Lantern from another asset, such as a crop (A7). `imported`: copied in from another library or tool.

parameters.name: rating_min
parameters.description: Only assets rated at least this (1 to 5).

parameters.name: created_after
parameters.description: Only assets that entered the library at or after this time.

parameters.name: created_before
parameters.description: Only assets that entered the library before this time.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many assets per page, 1 to 200; 50 when absent.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page. Opaque.

parameters.name: lib
parameters.description: A library id: `lib_` and a ULID.

schema.description: One page of assets.

id.description: An asset id: the SHA-256 of the asset's bytes, as 64 lowercase hex digits.

media_type.description: The MIME type of the bytes, e.g. `image/png`.

bytes.description: The size of the file, in bytes.

frames.description: Frames in an animation; null for a still image.

origin.description: `generated`: a job made it. `uploaded`: sent to this library. `derived`: made by Lantern from another asset, such as a crop (A7). `imported`: copied in from another library or tool.

bytes_state.description: `present`: the bytes are on disk. `trashed`: deleted by a person. `evicted`: a client copy removed to save space. Only `present` assets can be fetched.

retention.description: `keep`: kept until deleted. `client_copy`: a copy made for a client, which may be evicted.

anyOf.description: A rating from 1 to 5.

pixel_hash.description: A hash of the decoded pixels (A25): equal hashes are identical images whatever the metadata. Null where it isn't computed (images other than PNG).

pixel_hash_alg.description: How `pixel_hash` was computed; hashes compare only under the same algorithm.

created_at.description: When the asset entered this library.

output_of.description: The job output this asset is; null for an asset no job made.

anyOf.description: Which job output this asset is.

job_id.description: The job that made the asset.

index.description: The asset's place among the job's outputs.

seed.description: The seed this output used (the base seed plus its index), when known.

model_id.description: The model the job ran on.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last one.

state.description: `queued`: in Lantern's queue (see `blocked_reason`). `submitting`: being sent. `dispatched`: the backend has it, not yet generating (`progress.waiting` says why). `running`: generating. `cancel_requested`: cancel asked of a job the backend cannot stop; its outputs are discarded. `finished`: see `outcome`.

retry_after.description: The scheduler leaves the job alone until then.

anyOf.description: How a finished job ended.

outcome_reason.description: `backend_error`, `backend_lost`, `interrupted`, `ingest_failed`, `route_missing`, `user`, or the backend's reason for a refusal.

model_id.description: A model id.

anyOf.description: What the backend reports, as far as the route's `control.progress` allows; absent fields are unknown.

waiting.description: Why the backend has not started it.

reason.description: `memory`, `loading`, `calibrating`, `engine_queue` or `other` (L5).

anyOf.description: When it was sent to the backend.

post.summary: Resolve a generation request without running it
post.description: The dry run: validates the request against the model's routes, chooses a route, fills every default by precedence (request > preset > model overrides > profile > route default), draws a seed for `"random"`, and reports what became of each field. A value the request sets is never changed: one the route can't take is a 422 whose issue may carry a `suggested` value.
